{{Quote|We had better take Fumiyo, here, with us. He's the only native Godoan who has mastered Galactic Standard speech.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 99">[[Star Wars (1977) 99|''Star Wars'' (1977) 99]]</ref>}}
'''Fumiyo''' was a [[Godoan/Legends|Godoan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the only known member of his [[Species/Legends|species]] to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. As such, when the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] arrived on his planet to attempt to help the citizens in their fight with [[Godoan's disease]], Fumiyo helped inform the Alliance of the plight that was affecting the native Godoans.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] eventually noted that the statues of the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]] and the [[Minstrel]] were key to saving the Godoans and retrieved them. Fumiyo later helped save [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] life, when the man had contracted the disease.
